summary: A backcountry tourer/skier was caught, buried and killed in an avalanche in the area locally known as Chimney Chute, a steep, narrow, northeast-facing below-treeline chute in the First Creek Drainage of Berthoud Pass; the body was located by Grand County SAR members with an avalanche probe, and the Grand County Sheriff and GCSAR worked into the night to recover it.
location: Chimney Chute, First Creek Drainage, Berthoud Pass
responding_agency: Grand County Search and Rescue; Grand County Sheriff's Office
notes: Per the CAIC 12/26/20 advisory quoted in the source: preliminary reports placed the slide in Chimney Chute (First Creek Drainage, Berthoud Pass); the backcountry tourer was found by GCSAR with a probe; CAIC forecasters visited the site the next day. 5th avalanche fatality of the 2020/21 winter season. Victim identity not published in sources found. Merged CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row.
